nodes.label: glkvm-gui logo (logo-256.png)
nodes.description: Application icon for the glkvm-gui desktop app. A rounded-square (macOS/iOS style) icon with a dark navy-to-near-black radial gradient background. Centered is a line-art computer monitor/display rendered with a cyan-to-blue gradient stroke, a dark screen, and a stand/base. A solid white mouse-cursor arrow sits on the screen. Visually encodes KVM (keyboard-video-mouse) remote control: a remote display operated by a pointer.

attributes.icon_style: rounded-square app icon with gradient background
attributes.palette: dark navy background, cyan-to-blue accent gradient, white cursor
attributes.key_elements: computer monitor, screen, stand, white mouse cursor arrow
attributes.purpose: brand/app identity for glkvm-gui; signals remote screen + input control (KVM over IP)

nodes.label: Remote display / monitor
nodes.description: The computer monitor motif representing the video/display side of a KVM: the remote machine's screen streamed to the GUI.

nodes.label: Mouse cursor / pointer input
nodes.description: The white cursor arrow representing the keyboard/mouse (input) side of KVM: the operator driving the remote host.

nodes.label: KVM remote control
nodes.description: The combined meaning of the icon: keyboard-video-mouse remote control over IP, the core function of the glkvm-gui application.
nodes.rationale: Monitor + cursor together are the conventional visual shorthand for remote-desktop / KVM tooling, matching the glkvm-gui app's role as a GUI client for a KVM-over-IP device.
